title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FUEL TANK VENT HOSE (394,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MINIVANS.     THE FUEL TANK VENT HOSE ALLOWS AIR TO VENT FROM THE FUEL TANK DURING REFUELING.  CRACKS HAVE DEVELOPED IN THE VENT HOSE.  IF (1) THE FUEL TANK IS OVERFILLED, NOT ALLOWING EXCESS FUEL IN THE VENT HOSE TO FLOW BACK INTO THE TANK, (2) THE VEHICLE IS DRIVEN ONLY A SHORT DISTANCE AFTER REFUELING AND, (3) THERE IS SUBSEQUENTLY SIGNIFICANT HEATING OF THE FUEL TANK, THE FUEL IN THE TANK CAN EXPAND INTO THE VENT HOSE AND LEAK FUEL.

title: Bridgestone Americas Tire Operations: FIRESTONE/TREAD SEPARATION (8,000 affected)
summary: TIRE DESCRIPTION:  WILDERNESS LE TIRES (BOTH BLACK AND RAISED WHITE LETTER TIRES) PRODUCED DURING THE WEEK OF APRIL 24, 2000 (THE SEVENTEENTH WEEK OF 2000) AT THE CUERNAVACA, MEXICO PLANT WITH TIRE SERIAL NUMBERS V672WL11700 (BLACKWALL) AND V672WL21700 (RAISED WHITE LETTERS).  THESE TIRES WERE USED AS ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT ON MODEL YEAR 2000 YUKON XL 1500 SERIES VEHICLES AND WERE ALSO OFFERED AS OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT ON THE 2000 CHEVROLET SUBURBAN 1500 SERIES VEHICLES.  TREAD SEPARATION CAN OCCUR DUE TO A LACK OF ADHESION TO THE FIRST STEEL BELT.

title: HENDRICKSON INTERNATIONAL: HENDRICKSON/GUNITE BRAKE DRUMS (357 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  GUNITE ERIE 2764-SERIES BRAKE DRUMS SUPPLIED TO HOLLAND BINKLEY DURING 1999 AND 2000 AS PART OF COMPLETE AXLE ASSEMBLIES.  THE BRAKE DRUMS ARE NOT COMPATIBLE WITH STEEL DISC WHEELS MANUFACTURED BY HAYES LEMMERZ INTERNATIONAL, INC.  THESE DRUMS BEAR DATE CODES BETWEEN "162 99" AND "225 99," INCLUSIVE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/TIRES (3,167 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 18-INCH TIRES.  (18-INCH TIRES ARE STANDARD EQUIPMENT ON THE M5 AND OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT ON THE 7-SERIES MODELS).  THE MACHINE USED TO MOUNT AND INFLATE THE TIRES ON THE WHEELS AT THE ASSEMBLY PLANT MAY HAVE DAMAGED THE SIDEWALL OF ONE OR MORE TIRES.  THE DAMAGED AREA COULD WEAKEN TO THE POINT WHERE A SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR FROM THE TIRE COULD OCCUR.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/FRONT SPRING STRUT (174 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.   THE SINGLE FRONT SPRING STRUT IS MOUNTED BETWEEN THE FRAME AND THE FRONT SUSPENSION ARM, AFT OF THE FRONT FORK TUBES.  DUE TO A WELDING PROBLEM DURING PRODUCTION OF THE SPRING STRUT, THE LOWER SPRING SEAT ON THE STRUT COULD BREAK.  SINCE THE SEAT IS THE LOWER SUPPORT FOR THE SPRING, THE SPRING IN THIS CASE WOULD THEN EXTEND TO ITS FULL LENGTH.  THIS WOULD CAUSE THE FRONT OF THE MOTORCYCLE'S FRAME TO DROP BY APPROXIMATELY 2.5 INCHES, WITHOUT WARNING.

title: RENEGADE RV: RENEGADE KIBBI/DEXTER AXLE/AXLES (111 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH  DEXTER AXLES THAT WERE MANUFACTURED WITH A BEARING OPTION KNOWN AS NEV-R-LUBE.  THE OPTIONAL HUB UTILIZES A SEALED CARTRIDGE BEARING WHICH IS HELD IN PLACE WITH A RETAINING RING THAT PREVENTS THE HUB FROM SHIFTING ON THE BEARING.  SOME OF THESE AXLE ASSEMBLIES WERE PRODUCED WITHOUT THE RETAINING RING.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/STEERING GEAR ASSEMBLY (636 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES.  AN INTERNAL NUT IN THE STEERING GEAR ASSEMBLY COULD LOOSEN AND CAUSE THE STEERING GEAR TO LOCK UP.

title: Utilimaster Corporation: UTILIMASTER/HEATER BLOWER MOTOR (15,762 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  WALK-IN DELIVERY VANS SUPPLIED TO THE UNITED STATES POSTAL SERVICE.  UNDER CERTAIN SNOW CONDITIONS, IF MOISTURE GETS INTO THE BLOWER MOTOR AND SUBSEQUENTLY REFREEZES, THE BLOWER MOTOR COULD SEIZE CAUSING A RESISTOR TO OVERHEAT.

title: J&J SALES, INC.: J&J/CERTIFICATION (777 affected)

summary: TIRE DESCRIPTION:  COOPER-AVON TYRES LIMITED MOTORCYCLE TIRES, SIZES 130/80R17 65H AND 140/80R17 69H MANUFACTURED BETWEEN JANUARY 3, 1994, AND MAY 13, 2000, AND 150/70R17 69H MANUFACTURED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 27, 1995, AND NOVEMBER 7, 1998. summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  HUBS FOR TRUCK TRAILER DISC WHEELS WITH DIRECT-MACHINED ABS OF PART NUMBER 2023A MANUFACTURED BETWEEN APRIL 14 AND JUNE 7, 2000 AND SHIPPED TO ARVINMERITOR BETWEEN MAY 3 AND OCTOBER 30, 2000. title: AMERICAN SUSPENSION: AMERICAN SUSPENSION/FENDER BRACKETS (3,228 affected)

title: Meritor, Inc.: ARVINMERITOR/BRAKE ROLLERS (23,400 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  "W-SERIES" AIR-ACTUATED BRAKE CAM ROLLERS PART NUMBERS:  1779-L-116, 1779-X-180, 1779-P-328, 1779-Q-329, 1779-S-331, AND 1779-U-593 SHIPPED TO CUSTOMERS BETWEEN MARCH 1 AND OCTOBER 31, 2000.  THESE ROLLERS WERE INSTALLED AS ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT AND ALSO SOLD AS REPLACEMENT PARTS.  THE AFFECTED BRAKE ROLLERS MAY FRACTURE IF SUBJECTED TO HIGH APPLICATION LOADINGS.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. Announce Recall of Motocross Motorcycles
summary: The rear brakes on these motorcycles can fail, causing a rider to lose control of the vehicle and crash, resulting in injuries or death. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, BBC International Ltd. Announce Recall of Crayola® Toddler Boots
summary: The toggle, a small plastic ball attached to the laces, can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 38,000.

title: CPSC, Black and Decker Inc. Announce Recall to Repair 12-inch Miter Saws
summary: Bolts on the saws can loosen and the blade could detach, posing a risk of lacerations to consumers. Units: About 6,400.

title: CPSC, DEWALT® Industrial Tool Co. Announce Recall to Repair 12-inch Miter Saws
summary: Bolts on the saws can loosen and the blade could detach, posing a risk of lacerations to consumers. Units: About 112,000.

title: CPSC, Trane Company Announce Recall of Voyager Heating and Air Conditioning Systems
summary: One of the three internal flue gas tubes extending from the heat exchanger can separate from the heat exchanger. This could allow flue gases, including carbon monoxide, to enter the building airstream. This could result in serious injury or death to building occupants. Units: 967.

title: Lamps Recalled by Environmental Lighting Concepts
summary: An electronic component inside the plug can overheat, presenting a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,560.

title: Rope Lights Recalled by CO2UCH
summary: The rope light controller, which allows consumers to choose the type of light motion, such as flash or chase, can short circuit. This poses shock, fire, and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 27,300.

title: Tree Wound and Grafting Compound Recalled by the Tanglefoot Co.
summary: Pressure can build inside the can and forcibly discharge the compound, which can cause temporary skin irritation. Units: About 35,000.

title: CPSC, Playskool Announce Recall to Replace Certain "Busy School Bus" Toys
summary: On certain units, the yellow "awning" piece above the bus' door can break loose, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 12,500.

title: CPSC Recommends Carbon Monoxide Alarm for Every Home
summary: Under certain conditions, fuel-burning appliances can produce deadly CO. However, with proper installation and maintenance, they are safe to use. Units: .

title: CPSC, Trends Clothing Corp. Announce Recall of Girls' Sweatshirts
summary: These sweatshirts have hood drawstrings. Children can get entangled and strangle in the drawstrings that catch on objects, including playground equipment, fences and tree branches. Units: About 6,600.

title: CPSC and Designer Classics LLC Announce Recall of Children's Jeans and Overalls
summary: The small decorative metal appliques on the legs of the garments can come loose and separate, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 11,000.

title: CPSC, Central Sprinkler Company Announce Voluntary Recall To Replace O-Ring Fire Sprinklers
summary: These sprinkler heads can corrode or minerals, salts and other contaminants in water can affect the rubber O-ring seals. These factors could cause the sprinkler heads not to activate in a fire. Units: 35 million.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Bicycles and Bicycle Components
summary: The recumbent bicycle's front fork steering tube can break, the frame of the 12-inch children's bicycle can break during use, the Cannondale bicycle forks can break, the Magura brakes could fail, the Supergo handlebars can crack and break, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and s

title: CPSC, Kenyon International Inc. Announce Recall of Portable Butane Stoves
summary: The unit's safety fuel shut-off system could fail to shut off when the fuel container is overheated. If overheated, the flame from the stove flares up, and cannot be controlled with the adjustment valve, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,500.

title: CPSC, Kole Imports Announce Recall of Contact Adhesive
summary: The adhesive contains toluene, which can present a fire and poisoning hazard to consumers. The packaging of this product does not have the required cautionary labeling, as required under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act. Units: About 90,000.

title: CPSC, Carter's® Announce Recall to Repair Infant Jumpsuits
summary: A ribbon that runs through the zipper pull tab can detach, resulting in a potential choking hazard. Units: About 600,000.

title: CPSC, Seattle Bike Supply Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
summary: Because the bikes' pedals are too low to the ground, they fail to meet federal bicycle standards. Children can lose control when a pedal strikes the ground, causing falls and injuries. Units: About 1,400.

title: Historical tsunami: waves up to 0.25 m, EL Salvador (2001-01-13)
summary: A tsunami on 2001-01-13 after an M7.7 earthquake. 844 deaths. From NOAA NCEI's global historical tsunami database.
